notes: Phase 4 Louvain (Blondel et al. 2008) multilevel community detection via src/algorithms/community/louvain.rs. Rust beats python-igraph by 2.5x-3.6x on the small benchmarks: the Cython binding overhead and per-call Python object marshalling dominate for graphs in the karate/ring-of-cliques size range, where our pass loop runs entirely on Vec<f64> with no allocation per pass iteration. SplitMix64 + Fisher-Yates keeps the shuffle hot. Aggregation step rebuilds the super-graph via init_from_edges (shared with the level-0 init) so self-loops at level k+1 honour the IGRAPH_LOOPS_TWICE convention consistently. Next optimisation lever (if we ever need it): swap the per-pass `weight_to_community` HashMap for a dense Vec keyed on community id with a small-int generation tag.
